# Expeditions With Jo

> Help for CARICOM nationals working out how to visit, work or study in another CARICOM country, and getting the paperwork and travel organised once they know. Run by Joanson Baptiste James, who has personally moved between CARICOM countries (Grenada to Trinidad and Tobago, then to Jamaica) and worked through what all twelve CSME member states require.

CARICOM (the Caribbean Community) is 12 member states with a shared free-movement regime (the CSME — CARICOM Single Market and Economy). Rules here are specific to those 12 states and do not apply to other Caribbean countries outside CARICOM.

## Core pathways

- [Visit](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/getting-there): Travel requirements, flights, accommodation and transfers for a visit to another CARICOM country.
- [Work](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/getting-started): Working in another CARICOM country, including the CARICOM Skills Certificate, job offers, job seeking, and business setup.
- [Study](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/study): Studying in another CARICOM country — free movement does not cover study, so a separate student visa or permit usually applies.
- [CARICOM Skills Certificate](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/caricom-skills-certificate): The document that lets an eligible skilled CARICOM national work in another member state without a work permit, country by country.
- [Business Setup](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/business-setup): Registering a business in another CARICOM country under the CARICOM Right of Establishment.
- [Banking](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/finance): What banks in CARICOM member states ask for to open a personal or business account.

## Services

- [Our Services](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/services): Move Planning Consultation, CSME Skills Certificate assistance, and Complete Relocation Support.
- [Plan My Move](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/plan-my-move): Start an enquiry.

## Reference

- [Country Guides](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/destinations): Cost of living and practical guidance for each CARICOM country.
- [CARICOM Move Basics](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/guides): Free guides covering CSME categories, free movement vs. the Skills Certificate, and permanent residence in Belize and Jamaica.
- [Currency Converter](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/tools/currency-converter): Live rates across the CARICOM currencies plus USD, CAD and GBP.
- [Translator](https://www.expeditionswithjo.com/tools/translator): Translation between the official languages spoken across CARICOM member states.
